title: Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms) — Schedule of Payment Terms, Invoicing and Statements
content:
Payment terms on Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms) are set by the account's terms tier. Each invoice falls due the tier's number of payment-terms days after the invoice date; terms count from the invoice date; an order is invoiced at fulfilment (pickup, delivery or shipment); orders are grouped into invoices as the tier provides; and the monthly account statement is issued on the tier's statement day.

## Schedule

| Terms tier | Payment terms (calendar days after the invoice date) | Terms count from | When an order is invoiced | How orders are grouped into invoices | How invoices and statements are delivered | Statement day (day of month) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Net 15 | 15 | Invoice date | At fulfilment | One invoice per order | Email | 1 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Standard | 30 | Invoice date | At fulfilment | One invoice per order | Email | 1 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Preferred | 30 | Invoice date | At fulfilment | Weekly | Email | 1 |
| Northgate Business Net 45 Volume | 45 | Invoice date | At fulfilment | Monthly | Email and the business portal | 1 |
| Northgate Business Net 60 Enterprise | 60 | Invoice date | At fulfilment | Monthly | Email and the business portal | 1 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Public Sector | 30 | Invoice date | At fulfilment | One invoice per order | The business portal | 1 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Payment terms.** The figure is the number of calendar days after the invoice date by which an invoice is due; the due date shown on an invoice is the invoice date plus the tier's payment terms.
2. **Terms start.** On every tier the terms count from the invoice date.
3. **Invoice timing.** On every tier an order is invoiced at fulfilment, meaning pickup, delivery or shipment.
4. **Grouping.** The grouping column states how orders are grouped into invoices. Where several orders are grouped into one invoice, the order shown on that invoice is the last order included.
5. **Invoice amount.** An invoice total includes tax and fees; the sales tax included is shown on the invoice.
6. **Statement day.** The monthly account statement is issued on the 1st of each month on every tier, and late charges are assessed on that day.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical dates)

| Hypothetical invoice date | Tier's payment terms | Due date |
|---|---|---|
| 4 June | 45 days | 19 July |
| 4 June | 15 days | 19 June |
| 4 June | 60 days | 3 August |

Each due date is the invoice date with the tier's calendar days added: from 4 June, 26 days reach 30 June, and the remaining days run on into the following months.

## Points of judgement

- *Two tiers both show 30 days — do they share the same terms?* The payment-terms figure is the same for Net 30 Standard, Net 30 Preferred and Net 30 Public Sector; they differ in how orders are grouped and how invoices are delivered, as the schedule shows.
- *Does a weekly or monthly grouping change when terms start?* No. Terms count from the invoice date on every tier.
